summary: Iteration 18 — Dealership group toggle + cascade verified end-to-end. BACKEND (5/5 pytest passed, /app/backend/tests/test_dealership_cascade.py): (1) PATCH /api/admin/dealerships/{id} {active:false} cascades active=false to ALL non-archived users of the dealership; response returns updated dealership doc. (2) Suspended users can no longer log in — POST /api/auth/login returns 403 for both cascaded users. (3) PATCH with {active:true} re-enables the dealership + all non-archived users; login succeeds again. (4) Cascade does NOT touch archived users — archived_at is preserved and the archived user stays archived while the non-archived teammate is cascaded to inactive. (5) GET /api/admin/dealers now returns a `dealership: {id, name, active, address?}` object on every dealer that has a dealership_id (verified on 5 real dealerships from the seed data). FRONTEND (admin, desktop 1440x900, /app/frontend/app/(app)/dealers.tsx): the Dealers tab now renders a SectionList with 14 grouped headers (each `testID=group-<dealership_id>`) covering all 20 seeded dealer rows. Each header shows the dealership name, user count (e.g. 'Ford Bryanston · 2 users') and an ACTIVE/DISABLED master Switch (`testID=group-toggle-<dealership_id>`). Multi-user dealerships found: 6 groups with 2 users each (Ford Bryanston, TEST E2E Motors, TEST Add-User Motors, etc.) — each renders as ONE group with BOTH users nested underneath, matching the review requirement. Toggling Ford Bryanston's group switch: (a) fired PATCH /api/admin/dealerships/{id} → 200, (b) pill flipped to 'DISABLED', (c) both nested users (Johann Linsky + Zelda Visagie) rendered the individual 'SUSPENDED' pill and per-user toggle flipped off, (d) header stats went from '19 active · 1 suspended' to '17 active · 3 suspended' — cascade of 2 confirmed. Re-toggling back restored ACTIVE state, users returned to ACTIVE. REGRESSION: (i) Add User modal (testID `invite-submit`, `invite-first_name` etc.) still opens from `dealer-add-teammate-<user_id>` on every dealer row; verified with programmatic click. (ii) Per-user individual toggles (`dealer-active-toggle-<id>`) still present on all 20 dealer cards. (iii) Edit / Reset PW / Photos / Archive buttons still render on each dealer row (Edit, Photos, Reset PW, Add User, red delete visible in screenshots). No 'solo:' synthetic groups needed — all 20 seeded dealers have real dealership_id (backend migration is complete). Deprecated packages detected: none new (pre-existing 'shadow*' style prop deprecation warnings from react-native-web remain — unrelated to this iteration). SafeAreaView issues detected: none.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2548-2572 PATCH /admin/dealerships correctly guards `active` cascade with `archived_at: {$in: [None, ''] }` so archived users are NOT reactivated by a group toggle — verified by test_cascade_does_not_touch_archived_users. Clean.

server.py:2641-2650 /admin/dealers response enriches each dealer with the parent `dealership` doc (id, name, active, address). This lets the client group without a second API call and keeps the reload-free optimistic update in dealers.tsx working.

dealers.tsx:238-265 grouping useMemo correctly falls back to `solo:<user_id>` for legacy users without a dealership_id, and toggleDealershipActive (line 267-294) refuses to PATCH synthetic IDs with a helpful error — good defensive coding.

dealers.tsx:284-288 after a successful PATCH the local state is mirrored (users cascaded to `active: next` and dealership.active updated) to avoid a full refetch — matches backend cascade behaviour exactly. Verified visually.

dealers.tsx:594-624 sticky headers are DISABLED (stickySectionHeadersEnabled={false}) which is the right call for a scrollable admin list — otherwise the master toggle would visually cover dealer rows.

dealers.tsx:502 Add-User button falls back to `item.id` when dealership_id is missing — this would POST to /admin/dealerships/{user_id}/users which would 404, but that path is only taken for the solo legacy edge case which no longer exists in the seed. Minor future-proofing suggestion but non-blocking.
Test coverage is now comprehensive: individual toggle (test_billing_dealers.py from earlier iterations) + group cascade (this iteration) + login suspension (this iteration) all covered.
